text:
riley: quick UX sync 1  prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-footer-ux  goal: compact footer with token pill + stop + regenerate. Need quick takes on wording, placement, and screen reader behavior.

sam: prefer footer next to send. users expect runtime actions near composer.

kate: wording: use 'Stop' (backend discards partial output). 'Pause' would imply resume which we don't support reliably. regen label: 'Regenerate' clear.

diego: a11y notes: token pill use aria-live=\"polite\" with 500ms debounce; final announcement should be role=\"status\": \"Response complete. X tokens used.\" Stop button aria-label: \"Stop response and discard partial output\". Also add Esc shortcut to stop.

a11y-bot: automated check: color contrast for token pill on light theme fails (3.1:1). Recommend bg #111827, text #F9FAFB or 1px border + #111827 text.

riley: great, I'll update comps, add keyboard shortcut in PR, and keep token meter hidden when idle (setting to persist opt-in). will post updated screenshots later. :sparkles:
